parameters.gold: σ Daily transition rate E1→E2 and E2→I1 (two-stage latent period)
parameters.extracted: σ Daily progression rate through exposed/latent stages (E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁). Mean latent/incubation period d_L = 2*(1/σ) days.

parameters.gold: γ Daily transition rate I1→I2 and I2→R (two-stage infectious period)
parameters.extracted: γ Daily progression rate through infectious stages (I₁→I₂ and I₂→R). Mean infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ) days.

parameters: λ(t) Force of infection at time t; proportional to infectious individuals under homogeneous mixing.
β Transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in λ(t).
p_ICU Probability (proportion) of infected individuals who are admitted to ICU/HDU (severity given infection).
μ_ICU|E Mean delay from infection/exposure to ICU/HDU admission (used in convolution observational model; Gamma-distributed waiting time).
σ²_ICU|E Variance of delay from infection/exposure to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time).
η Negative Binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts.
π Initial susceptibility / proportion non-immune at start of season (used for identifiability and to compute effective reproduction number R_n).
λ₀ Initial infection rate / initial force of infection (used in early exponential growth re-parameterization).
ψ Early exponential growth rate (EGR) parameter used to re-parameterize the transmission model at epidemic start.
β Transmission rate in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N (homogeneous mixing)

observations: Missed 3 compartment(s), 6 flow(s), 1 parameter(s) from gold standard.
Hallucinated 3 compartment(s), 5 flow(s), 9 parameter(s) not in gold standard.
